title: DANCE: Dual-Side Agile N:M Sparse Compressed Digital CiM Accelerator for Efficient Compound AI
problem: Existing CiM accelerators have rigid array structures unable to support fine-grained pruning for expert models and outlier-aware quantization for LLM router models needed in compound AI systems.
motivation: Compound AI combining LLMs with expert models requires flexible model compression support for efficient deployment.
method: Dual-side N:M sparse compressed digital CiM with set-associative selection circuits for weight and activation sparsity; unified framework integrating fine-grained pruning and outlier-aware quantization.
key_novelty: Customized set-associative circuit for N:M extraction on both weights and activations with unified compression framework for compound AI.
contributions: Set-associative selection circuit supporting N:M pattern extraction
Unified framework for fine-grained pruning and outlier-aware quantization
Cross-layer co-optimizations for compound AI workloads
4.36x energy efficiency for ResNet-18, 2.59x for Llama-7B

metrics.other: Maintains high parallelism with N:M sparsity

limitations: N:M sparsity pattern constraint limits pruning flexibility; evaluation limited to ResNet-18 and Llama-7B.
primary_theme: Flexible CiM accelerator for compound AI
